qualification.format: OSwind test-only collector vault phase qualification

independentReview.scope: Read-only review after the reaped frozen driver: final test summaries, exact input/log/trace hashes, original-versus-known-control phase identity, owned-path redaction and exact traced image absence. Traces observe this test process only; neither passing runs nor deliberate held-reader controls identify the unknown historical CI cause.

developmentFailure.suite: 16 selected model-free cases; one new handle-boundary assertion failed
developmentFailure.note: Test helper omitted its owned descriptor. No production source or native detachment was exercised by this model-free case.

nativeDevelopmentProbe.scope: Native authored fixtures only; three expected held-reader exit16 controls are separate from unknown historical CI failure; no force detach, source fix or representative reliability rate claimed.

historicalNativeFailure.limits: Four named completed detach/query diagnostic reports do not identify the failing collector lock phase or its native cause; no forced detach or causal fix is claimed.

setupCleanup.nativeUI: Inventory now explicitly reports the Mac locked and automatic unlock unavailable. No unlock action, credentials or setting change through UI was attempted.
setupCleanup.note: One initial removal and a later fresh-process read prove progress from 14 to 13, then a fresh read proves 12. A subsequent removal returned status zero before its verification read timed out. Current count and final restoration remain unknown. No unrelated exclusion was targeted. A null or timed-out Metadata read is not proof of restoration.

latestReadOnlyRecheck.note: The read-only invocation omits --remove-one. Its bounded Metadata read times out and the process exits/reaps; neither current count nor restoration is established.

limits: No production source, closing policy, model, permission or indexing setting change. The public create-with-unlock path is preserved; the test-only driver observes subsequent credential-free operations.

The original workflow has distinct first/second-lock phases before cleanup. Two deliberate known-reader controls retain normal exit16 at each chosen phase, recover after closing that reader, preserve original collector text and verify final image absence. These controls do not reproduce or explain the unknown historical CI cause.

Trace output captures this test process only. Owned FD metadata includes legitimate package-operation leases outside the encrypted volume; mounted marks which handles are on that owned volume. No inference about external holders follows from an empty owned mounted-handle list.

Inventory and volume-info stdout are omitted; summaries retain status, termination, byte counts and hashes. Owned native output and file paths are bounded and root-redacted; a generated fixture credential in an export is refused. Public vault construction installs no trace observer.

The initial focused handle-boundary assertion fails because Foundation temporary-path aliases do not match F_GETPATH. The exact realpath prefix corrects this test helper and preserves unrelated-descriptor exclusion. That first failure remains retained.

No failed command is force-detached or silently retried. Exception traces preserve the failing phase and cleanup observations; they do not by themselves prove cleanup success. Independent final attachment-absence checks reported here cover the successful traced fixtures.

The full suite retains one explicit system-audio fixture opt-in skip and one native session/thermal admission skip. Sanitizer evidence covers selected tests and does not prove all framework/kernel paths race-free. No GUI/authentication, sustained power, representative daily-use reliability or whole-product parity claim.

Earlier benchmark startup added task-only Spotlight exclusions. Last successful read showed 12; later verification is unavailable while the native session/Metadata API is unavailable. Current count and final restoration remain unverified. This qualification adds no exclusion.
remaining: Identify an unforced historical native detach failure phase and ownership cause if it recurs; do not infer a fix from green runs.
